frames.narration: The application asks for an order status as JSON, and describes the tool it offers: get_order(order_id).
Attempt 1: the model wraps the JSON in friendly text. The parser rejects it: invalid JSON.
Attempt 2: valid JSON, but the order id is a string. The schema check rejects it: wrong shape.
Attempt 3 is valid. With constrained decoding, attempt 1 could never have happened, because tokens that break the grammar are masked out.
The model replies with a tool call, not text: get_order with order_id 42. The application checks the name and the arguments.
The application runs the tool and sends the result back. A call to delete_all, which was never offered, is refused. The model never runs anything itself.
